about: v3.1.32's merge into the fork: guard-removal proofs for SHEP-211 as adapted to the fork's launch admission, run by bin/check-sensitivity --ledger (Check's own step beside Q's and PR 60's). Each mutation removes one part of the adapted switch (the old agent ending once nothing can refuse the new start and before it is sent, and only when hc says it ended; the switch nudge on a resumed session only) or a control it must keep (an agent switching itself ends after), or the data-back mark SHEP-210's new Back dropped, or the remote artifact cache and truncated-read refusal Nathan chose for SHEP-209's ranges, and the named CLI regression, whose stand-in hc has the old agent live, must fail by an assertion; with the source restored it must pass. Not part of Q's or PR 60's ledgers.
